title: Ndupe
description: N+1 shulker box copy plug-in, only paper1.21.3 is supported, and the shulker box is copied every 10 times
body:
# Ndupe
# Chinese
一个复制插件，每挖掘十次潜影盒复制一次，并在控制台输出提示。

修改项目源代码来修改复制一次潜影盒需要挖掘的次数

# English
A copy plugin that copies the shulker box every ten mines and outputs a hint in the console.

Modify the project source code to modify the number of times it takes to copy a shulker box

# Github
github: https://github.com/Andy-177/Ndupe/tree/main
